question: What are the two main parts corresponding to Lasya and Tandava elements in Manipuri dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jagoi and Cholom**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jagoi and Cholom** are the two main parts corresponding to Lasya and Tandava elements in Manipuri dance.
 
• Manipuri dance, also known as Jagoi, is one of the major Indian classical dance forms, originating from the state of Manipur.
